name: Crewe Athletics Track (Cumberland Arena)
metaTitle: Crewe Athletics Track (Cumberland Arena) | Info & Wind Speed
metaDescription: Check live wind speed and track information for Crewe Athletics Track (Cumberland Arena) in Crewe.

trackInfo.heading: Opening Times
trackInfo.text:
Public track sessions:

Monday: 5:00 pm – 6:00 pm, 6:30 pm – 8:00 pm
Wednesday: 4:30 pm – 6:00 pm, 7:00 pm – 8:30 pm
Friday: 5:00 pm – 6:30 pm, 6:30 pm – 8:00 pm
Saturday: 9:00 am – 12:00 pm
Sunday: 8:30 am – 10:00 am, then 2:00 pm – 8:00 pm

Crewe & Nantwich Athletics Club trains on Tuesdays and Thursdays, 5:30 pm – 8:00 pm. Hours can change for events and bank holidays, so check with the venue before travelling.

trackInfo.heading: Entry Price
trackInfo.text:
Pay as you go, per 60-minute session:

Adult: £4.90
Junior / Senior: £4.15
Wild Card holder: £3.90

No membership is needed. Track use is included in some Everybody memberships.

trackInfo.heading: Track Details
trackInfo.text:
Length: 400m oval
Field Facilities: Full field event equipment is available during allocated times.

trackInfo.heading: Parking Details
trackInfo.text: There is no on-site parking. The nearest car park is the Thomas Street public car park, about 0.2 miles away, which has 9 disabled bays. Blue Badge holders can park there free with no time limit.

trackInfo.heading: Address
trackInfo.text: Cumberland Arena, Thomas Street, Crewe, CW1 2BD

trackInfo.heading: Website
trackInfo.text: Visit the Everybody Health & Leisure website for session bookings and current times.
